I think that is a good idea. Since it got removed from the sdk it might be more convenient to drop it from all subsequent releases. If we are going to do 2.x releases the same way as we did for 1.x where we updated the sdk too we'd need to somehow add the zipkin exporter from the last sdk that had it.
Noticed that https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2025/deprecating-zipkin-exporters/#timeline-and-migration-path says
> Existing stable Zipkin exporters will continue to receive security patches and critical bug fixes until at least December 2026

could sdk remove it because it wasn't stable?
